verdict.rationale: Remote desktop software that relays user sessions could fairly be asked about AI-training data use, so the axis applies. The evidence contains no AI-training policy, opt-out, or no-training commitment. Self-hosting and the claim that 'self-hosted RustDesk keeps your data fully under your control' are general data-sovereignty features, adjacent to the story rather than a documented AI-training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
